en: Yesterday: two jugs, three litres and five litres. How do you get exactly four?
Fill the big jug, then pour it into the small jug. Two litres stay in the big jug.
Now empty the small jug, and pour those two litres into it.
Fill the big jug again, and top up the small jug. Only one more litre fits.
So exactly four litres are left in the big jug!
Person one has eight balls. They all look exactly the same.
But one ball is a little bit heavier than all the others.
Person one has a balance scale, and can use it only two times.
How can Person one find the heavy ball, for sure?
